hero.title: File:'Travel Town Museum' 01.jpg
hero.description: Travel Town Museum is a transport museum dedicated in the northwest corner of Los Angeles, California's Griffith Park. The history of railroad transportation in the western United States from 1880 to the 1930s is the primary focus of the museum's collection, with an emphasis on railroading in Southern California and the Los Angeles area.
